description: Run named Nagios plugins on this host and return one JSON document: per check the state, summary, parsed performance data and long output, and the worst state overall. The caller names the checks; this host's checks.conf (/etc/nagios-checks/checks.conf) says which plugin and arguments each name runs, so no plugin arguments are accepted. Checks run one after another within a run budget (default 50 s), each check capped at its timeout (default 10 s); a check the budget cannot cover is UNKNOWN "not run", and a "warning" field appears when the timeouts add up to more than the budget. Exit code is the overall state: 0 OK, 1 WARNING, 2 CRITICAL, 3 UNKNOWN (also any wrapper error). Makes no changes of its own. check_config parses a given config file and runs nothing.

checks.description: Names of the checks to run, as configured on the agent (see list). Run in the order given.

list.description: List the checks this host offers, each with the plugin name and whether that plugin is available (available, and a reason when not), instead of running any. Exits 3 when any plugin is not available.

check_config.description: Path of a config file to parse with the same rules as the real one, running nothing: returns its checks (name, plugin, available) and settings; exit 0 if it parses (a missing plugin shows available false), 3 with an error naming the line if it does not. Used as the validate command when the config is deployed.

all.description: Run every check configured on this host.
